root_cause: Repair loop only triggers on error/zero rows, so silently-wrong non-empty drafts (duplicate rows from multi-enrolment joins, NULL-poisoned NOT IN inside UNION) are never re-examined
what: solve.py now also triggers the single repair call when a successful draft shows a structural defect: duplicate result rows (checked with SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ...) over the draft's own projection) or a NOT IN whose subquery contains NULLs (fixed probe that counts NULLs per output column instead of the invalid 'sub.*' syntax). The follow-up carries these concrete facts and tells the model to de-duplicate only if the question asks for entities rather than events; no extra calls on clean drafts.

root_cause: Non-empty drafts with wrong result shape go unchecked: 1:N joins duplicate entity rows and bare 'which <entity>' questions are under-projected
what: Adds two general result-shape rules to system_prompt.md: de-duplicate (DISTINCT/GROUP BY) when listing entities reachable through a one-to-many join unless per-occurrence rows are asked for, and return the entity's full record (SELECT main.*, plus matched child columns when a join is needed) for bare 'which <entity>' questions while keeping explicit column lists exact. No code or config change, so no extra policy calls.
